comment:
**Verified (source review):** No actionable defect found in the scoped review of `d19530e0`. Network popup labels, controls and credential fields now use `Color.popups.text`, matching the popup card's `Color.popups.background`; the bar icon keeps its bar palette.

| Color input | Baseline | This PR |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Ordinary popup content | `bar.foreground` | `popupForeground = Color.popups.text` |
| Row hover/selection helpers | Bar foreground argument | Popup foreground argument |
| Bar icon | Bar palette | Unchanged |

The fill helpers still honor explicit theme state-color overrides, so the changed argument does not guarantee different hover/selection colors for every theme. Urgent indicators remain unchanged.

---
